items.title: Review: Young Travelers Are Warming Up to Cruises
items.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg News travel journalist Brittany Chang explains why cruises are attracting more Gen Z and millennial travelers as higher airfare and hotel costs make all-inclusive vacations increasingly appealing. Chang tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that cruise lines are courting younger passengers with mega ships, entertainment, adult-only spaces and nostalgia, with some sailings costing as little as about $30 a day. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Economy and Democracy Drove the Blue Wave
items.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Rutgers University's Ashley Koning says affordability, concerns about democracy and government corruption helped drive voters toward Democrats, with significant shifts among Latino, young and independent voters. Koning tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that Democrats now face pressure to deliver tangible results on affordability before the 2028 election cycle. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Berkshire Makes Record $9.6 Billion Buyback
items.summary: On Bloomberg This Weekend, Bloomberg Intelligence Senior Insurance Analyst Matthew Palazola breaks down Berkshire Hathaway's third-quarter results, including a record $9.6 billion in share buybacks and weaker insurance earnings. Palazola tells hosts David Gura and Christina Ruffini that CEO Greg Abel is putting Berkshire's massive cash reserves to work through buybacks, acquisitions and equity investments while maintaining the measured approach associated with Warren Buffett. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: Review: Turkey Arrests Former Regulatory Executive in Growing Fund Probe
items.summary: Turkish authorities arrested the former deputy chairman of the country’s markets regulator, state-run Anadolu Agency reported on Saturday, the latest executive to be caught up in a widening fund scandal.

items.title: Review: Illeana Douglas Looks Back on Hollywood’s Biggest ‘Cat Fight’

items.title: Review: Democrats plan to widen their probes of fatal ICE shootings
items.summary: The killings of Renee Good and Alex Pretti during the ICE surge in Minneapolis last winter was a pivotal moment for the country. After Democrats' sweeping wins this week, their deaths at the hands of immigration agents will likely be the targets of renewed investigations.
